items.stem: A SOC analyst receives an alert for impossible-travel logins. Which telemetry best confirms whether the account was actually compromised?

options.text: Identity provider sign-in logs showing locations, devices and MFA results
options.rationale: Correct: sign-in logs directly show the authentication context needed to judge the alert.
Byte counts do not reveal who signed in or from where.

options.text: A list of installed applications on the server
options.rationale: Installed apps do not confirm an authentication event.

items.explanation: Correct: sign-in logs directly show the authentication context needed to judge the alert.

items.stem: Which two factors should drive the priority of an alert during triage? (Select TWO)

options.text: The business impact if the alert is a true positive
options.rationale: Correct: impact is a core triage dimension.

options.text: The confidence that the alert is a true positive
options.rationale: Correct: confidence (fidelity) is a core triage dimension.

options.text: The alphabetical order of the alert name
options.rationale: Ordering by name is arbitrary and not risk-based.

options.text: How recently the SIEM licence was renewed
options.rationale: Licensing is unrelated to alert priority.

items.explanation: Correct: impact is a core triage dimension.; Correct: confidence (fidelity) is a core triage dimension.

items.stem: What does mean time to detect (MTTD) measure?

options.text: The average time from when an incident begins to when the SOC detects it
options.rationale: Correct: MTTD is the gap between occurrence and detection.

options.text: The average time to fully recover a system after an incident
options.rationale: That describes recovery time, not detection.

options.text: The number of alerts generated per day
options.rationale: That is alert volume, not a time metric.

options.text: The cost of the SIEM per analyst
options.rationale: That is a cost metric, unrelated to detection time.

items.explanation: Correct: MTTD is the gap between occurrence and detection.
